items.description: The GET DigitalHealth mashup enables a clinical trial sponsor, clinical research organization or an academic researcher/investigators to set up a study, select wearables/devices and start receiving data from study participants. Participants have to click on an invite link, sign the consent, and provide authorization for the device data to be accessed by Get DigitalHealth. The platform provides study teams the ability to export data to a spreadsheet, visualize or directly push data to clinical trial management systems such as the Medidata and OpenClinical. The mashup features insightful analytics, HIPAA compliant security, normalized, intelligent data retrieval, intergration with EHR and CTMS, and more.

This is the unofficial Android dependent on the REFUGE Restrooms AP. The app allows users to interact with the database of restrooms safe for transgender, intersex, gender nonconforming, as well as handicapped individuals. Users can search a map to view drop-pins for restroom locations nearest to their proximity. Also, the app displays short bios on the restroom so that users are informed.
A mashup for the ancient Roman road Via Claudia Augusta between Konigsbrunn and Epfach in Germany.
A resource for california parents and home buyers to explore the performance of their local school. Displays schools color coded by their rank and API scores.
Create fullscreen generative compositions based on Kuler themes via a Flash interface.
Displays volcanos of the world on a Google Map. Data from the Smithsonian Institution, Global Vulcanism Project

Doctor Who - unlike Star Trek which always used the same rock for its location filming - was surprisingly varied in its choice of quarries. This mashup shows where they are all and includes a kml for Google Earth.

You are at a scenic overlook and see distant summits. Find out what they are with HeyWhatsThat which provides panoramic sketches and the names of peaks. Browse panoramas that others have requested and generate your own.
The TurnHere video service chronicles different neighborhoods and places across the country through the use of Internet video films. This map plots their locations.

This is the 3rd in the moveable series, that started with Moveable Weather, and then moved on to Moveable Tides. This time, this Tropo/Google Latitude/Wikipedia mashup reads to from Wikipedia pages about places registered on the National Registry of Historic Places. (U.S only). You can surf virtually, or actually visit the locations with your GPS-enabled phone.
Find useful information about Singapore places
Nice integration of library data like what you have checked-out or are waiting forinto an automatically updating Google Gadget. Initially for Ann Arbor District Library. Talis mashup contest winner.
A mashup of Napa Valley wineries using Google Maps and Flickr.
Simple Amazon search interface that filters items to show only things eligible for Amazon Prime free shipping.
A tourism and venue website. Brings together thousands of audio, video, and PDF files about places to visit in over 20 countries. Uses RSS feeds and Google Maps.

Find commercial real estate with Coldwell Banker Commercial maps. Combines the listings of CBC with a full screen auto resizing map in the background powered by Virtual Earth. You can draw your own polygons for search as well.

Printout Designer enables you to streamline your shipping process with the ability to create invoices, picking slips and labels in a matter of seconds. You can easily batch print, download or email all your printouts with couple of clicks. Our users say that Printout Designer allows them to process their orders up to FIVE times faster than their previous solution. They have even called us the “Swiss-army knife for printing”. Our survey shows that users who process up to 100 orders per month save 2-5 hours each month and users who process up to 1000 orders per month say that they save around 15 hours each month.
An nice explorative Flash-based interface into Flickr photos. With tag search, interestingness sorting, user tabs, and related tags.
Spain used cars dealers. To see a map click on any province and select &quotMapa de Vendedores&quot.
Find and map the Craigslist yard sales near you. Find, organize, and print directions to yard sales in your area. You can make live updates to your itinerary to find the fastest route.
A new developing comparison shopping mashup using Shopping.com API.
Look for public Flickr photos with this tag-based search.
